reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week starting in March 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
), weekly AS (
  -- one row per week with sales
  SELECT order_week AS week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_week BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY order_week
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly s ON s.week_start = w.week_start
alternatives:
SELECT w.week_start, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) FROM sales s WHERE s.order_week = w.week_start) AS units
FROM (
  -- one row per week starting in March 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM calendar WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
) AS w

SELECT week_start, SUM(units) AS units
FROM weekly_units
WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY week_start

solver.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS week_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-31', INTERVAL 7 DAY) t(d)
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS units
FROM w
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.order_date >= w.week_start AND s.order_date < w.week_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY w.week_start
